name: 酸液飞溅
effect:
敏捷豁免。1d6强酸。5/11/17 级升骰。

You create an acidic bubble at a point 在射程内, where it explodes in a 5 尺半径 球状. Each creature in that 球状 必须通过一次敏捷豁免，否则 take 1d6 强酸伤害.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d6，11 级 3d6，17 级 4d6。

name: 剑刃防护
effect:
专注。

Whenever a creature makes an 攻击检定 against you before the spell ends, the attacker subtracts 1d4 from the 攻击检定.

name: 颤栗之触
effect:
近战法术攻击。1d10黯蚀。5/11/17 级升骰。

Channeling the chill of the grave, make a melee spell attack against a target within reach. 若命中，目标受到 1d10 黯蚀伤害, and it can't regain 生命值 until the end of your next turn.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d10，11 级 3d10，17 级 4d10。

name: 舞光术
effect:
专注。

You create up to four torch-size lights 在射程内, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover 在持续时间内. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds 微光 in a 10 尺 radius.
As a 附赠动作, you can move the lights up to 60 尺 to a space 在射程内. A light must be within 20 尺 of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.

name: 德鲁伊伎俩
effect:
见规则书。

Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects 在射程内.
【Weather Sensor】
You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.
【Bloom】
You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.
【Sensory Effect】
You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5 尺 立方.
【火焰 Play】
You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.

name: 魔能爆
effect:
远程法术攻击。1d10力场。5/11/17 级额外射线。

你掷出一道噼啪作响的能量束。对射程内一个生物或物体进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 1d10 力场伤害.

【戏法增强】
第 5 级产生两道射线，第 11 级三道，第 17 级四道。你可将射线打向同一或不同目标。每道射线分别进行一次攻击检定。

name: 四象法门
effect:
见规则书。

You exert control over the elements, creating one of the following effects 在射程内.
【Beckon Air】
You create a breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters, all in a 5 尺 立方. Doors and shutters being held open by someone or something aren't affected.
【Beckon Earth】
You create a thin shroud of dust or sand that covers surfaces in a 5 尺-square area, or you cause a single word to appear in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand.
【Beckon 火焰】
You create a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke in a 5 尺 立方. You choose the color and scent, and the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in that area. The smoke's scent lingers for 1 minute.
【Beckon Water】
You create a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5 尺 立方. Alternatively, you create 1 cup of clean water either in an open container or on a surface, and the water evaporates in 1 minute.
【Sculpt Element】
You cause dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit in a 1 尺 立方 to assume a crude shape (such as that of a creature) for 1 hour.

name: 火焰箭
effect:
远程法术攻击。1d10火焰。5/11/17 级升骰。

你向射程内一个生物或物体投出一团火焰。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 1d10 火焰伤害. 被命中的可燃物体若未被着装或携带，将开始燃烧。

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d10，11 级 3d10，17 级 4d10。

name: 交友术
effect:
专注。感知豁免。

You magically emanate a sense of friendship toward one creature you can see 在射程内. 目标必须通过感知豁免，否则在持续时间内陷入魅惑。The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you have cast this spell on it within the past 24 hours.
The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an 攻击检定, deal damage, or force anyone to make a 豁免. 法术结束时，目标知道自己曾被你魅惑。

name: 神导术
effect:
专注。

You touch a willing creature and choose a skill. 直至法术结束，the creature adds 1d4 to any 属性检定 using the chosen skill.

name: 光亮术
effect:
见规则书。

You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. 直至法术结束，the object sheds 明亮光照 in a 20 尺 radius and 微光 for an additional 20 尺. The light can be colored as you like.
Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. 若你再次施展此法术，先前的效应结束。

name: 法师之手
effect:
见规则书。

A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose 在射程内. The hand lasts 在持续时间内. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 尺 away from you or if you cast this spell again.
When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.
As a 施法 action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 尺.
The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

name: 修复术
effect:
见规则书。

This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 尺 in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.
This spell can physically repair a magic item, but it can't restore magic to such an object.

name: 传讯术
effect:
见规则书。

You point toward a creature 在射程内 and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.
You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 尺 of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.

name: 心灵之楔
effect:
智力豁免。1d6心灵。5/11/17 级升骰。

You try to temporarily sliver the mind of one creature you can see 在射程内. 目标必须通过一次智力豁免，否则 take 1d6 心灵伤害 and subtract 1d4 from the next 豁免 it makes before the end of your next turn.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d6，11 级 3d6，17 级 4d6。

name: 次级幻象
effect:
见规则书。

You create a sound or an image of an object 在射程内 that lasts 在持续时间内. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.
If a creature takes a 研读 action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (调查) check against your 法术豁免 DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.
【Sound】
If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends.
【Image】
If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5 尺 立方. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

name: 毒气喷涌
effect:
远程法术攻击。1d12毒素。5/11/17 级升骰。

You spray toxic mist at a creature 在射程内. 对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 1d12 毒素伤害.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d12，11 级 3d12，17 级 4d12。

name: 魔法伎俩
effect:
见规则书。

You create a magical effect 在射程内. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time.
【Sensory Effect】
You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.
【火焰 Play】
You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.
【Clean or Soil】
You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.
【Minor Sensation】
You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.
【Magic Mark】
You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.
【Minor Creation】
You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

name: 燃火术
effect:
远程法术攻击。1d8火焰。5/11/17 级升骰。

A flickering flame appears in your hand and remains there 在持续时间内. While there, the flame emits no heat and ignites nothing, and it sheds 明亮光照 in a 20 尺 radius and 微光 for an additional 20 尺. 若你再次施展此法术，先前的效应结束。
直至法术结束，you can take a 施法 action to hurl fire at a creature or an object within 60 尺 of you. Make a ranged spell attack. 若命中，目标受到 1d8 火焰伤害.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d8，11 级 3d8，17 级 4d8。

name: 冷冻射线
effect:
远程法术攻击。1d8冷冻。5/11/17 级升骰。

A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature 在射程内. 对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，it takes 1d8 冷冻伤害, and its 速度 is reduced by 10 尺 直至你的下个回合开始.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d8，11 级 3d8，17 级 4d8。

name: 抵抗术
effect:
专注。

You touch a willing creature and choose a damage type: 强酸, 钝击, 冷冻, 火焰, 闪电, 黯蚀, 穿刺, 毒素, 光耀, 挥砍, or 雷鸣. When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by 1d4. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.

name: 圣火术
effect:
敏捷豁免。1d8光耀。5/11/17 级升骰。

Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see 在射程内. 目标必须通过一次敏捷豁免，否则 take 1d8 光耀伤害. The target gains no benefit from 半掩护 or Three-Quarters 掩护 for this save.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d8，11 级 3d8，17 级 4d8。

name: 橡棍术
effect:
1d8力场。5/11/17 级升骰。

A Club or Quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a d8. If the attack deals damage, it can be 力场伤害 or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).
The spell ends early if you cast it again or if you let go of the weapon.

【戏法增强】
The damage die changes when you reach levels 5 (d10), 11 (d12), and 17 (2d6).

name: 电爪
effect:
近战法术攻击。1d8闪电。5/11/17 级升骰。

闪电 springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. 对目标进行一次近战法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 1d8 闪电伤害, and it can't make 借机攻击 until the start of its next turn.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d8，11 级 3d8，17 级 4d8。

name: 术法爆发
effect:
远程法术攻击。1d8自选。5/11/17 级升骰。

You cast sorcerous energy at one creature or object 在射程内. Make a ranged 攻击检定 against the target. 若命中，目标受到 1d8 damage of a type you choose: 强酸, 冷冻, 火焰, 闪电, 毒素, 心灵, or 雷鸣.
If you roll an 8 on a d8 for this spell, you can roll another d8, and add it to the damage. When you cast this spell, the maximum number of these d8s you can add to the spell's damage equals your 施法属性调整值.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d8，11 级 3d8，17 级 4d8。

name: 维生术
effect:
见规则书。

Choose a creature 在射程内 that has 0 生命值 and isn't dead. The creature becomes Stable.

【戏法增强】
The range doubles when you reach levels 5 (30 尺), 11 (60 尺), and 17 (120 尺).

name: 点点星芒
effect:
远程法术攻击。1d8光耀。5/11/17 级升骰。

You launch a mote of light at one creature or object 在射程内. 对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 1d8 光耀伤害, and until the end of your next turn, it emits 微光 in a 10 尺 radius and can't benefit from the 隐形 状态.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d8，11 级 3d8，17 级 4d8。

name: 奇术
effect:
见规则书。

You manifest a minor wonder 在射程内. You create one of the effects below 在射程内. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time.
【Altered Eyes】
You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.
【Booming Voice】
Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have 优势 on Charisma (威吓) checks.
【火焰 Play】
You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.
【Invisible Hand】
You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.
【Phantom Sound】
You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice 在射程内, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers.
【Tremors】
You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.

name: 荆棘之鞭
effect:
近战法术攻击。1d6穿刺。5/11/17 级升骰。

You create a vine-like whip covered in thorns that lashes out at your command toward a creature in range. 对目标进行一次近战法术攻击。若命中，目标受到 1d6 穿刺伤害, and if it is Large or smaller, you can pull it up to 10 尺 closer to you.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d6，11 级 3d6，17 级 4d6。
materials: the stem of a plant with thorns

name: 鸣雷破
effect:
体质豁免。1d6雷鸣。5/11/17 级升骰。

Each creature in a 5 尺 光环 originating from you 必须通过一次体质豁免，否则 take 1d6 雷鸣伤害. The spell's thunderous sound can be heard up to 100 尺 away.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d6，11 级 3d6，17 级 4d6。

name: 亡者丧钟
effect:
感知豁免。1d8黯蚀。5/11/17 级升骰。

You point at one creature you can see 在射程内, and the single chime of a dolorous bell is audible within 10 尺 of the target. 目标必须通过一次感知豁免，否则 take 1d8 黯蚀伤害. If the target is missing any of its 生命值, it instead takes 1d12 黯蚀伤害.

【戏法增强】
The damage increases by one die when you reach levels 5 (2d8 or 2d12), 11 (3d8 or 3d12), and 17 (4d8 or 4d12).

name: 克敌先击
effect:
5/11/17 级升骰。

Guided by a flash of magical insight, you make one attack with the weapon used in the spell's casting. The attack uses your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If the attack deals damage, it can be 光耀伤害 or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

【戏法增强】
Whether you deal 光耀伤害 or the weapon's normal damage type, the attack deals extra 光耀伤害 when you reach levels 5 (1d6), 11 (2d6), and 17 (3d6).
materials: a weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP

name: 恶毒嘲笑
effect:
感知豁免。1d6心灵。5/11/17 级升骰。

You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at one creature you can see or hear 在射程内. 目标必须通过一次感知豁免，否则 take 1d6 心灵伤害 and have 劣势 on the next 攻击检定 it makes before the end of its next turn.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d6，11 级 3d6，17 级 4d6。

name: 光耀祷词
effect:
体质豁免。1d6光耀。5/11/17 级升骰。

Burning radiance erupts from you in a 5 尺 光环. Each creature of your choice that you can see in it 必须通过一次体质豁免，否则 take 1d6 光耀伤害.

【戏法增强】
伤害在 5 级增至 2d6，11 级 3d6，17 级 4d6。

name: 警报术
effect:
仪式。

You set an alarm against intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area 在射程内 that is no larger than a 20 尺 立方. 直至法术结束，an alarm alerts you whenever a creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won't set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is audible or mental:
• Audible Alarm：The alarm produces the sound of a handbell for 10 seconds within 60 尺 of the warded area.
• Mental Alarm：You are alerted by a mental ping if you are within 1 里 of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you're asleep.

name: 化兽为友
effect:
感知豁免。升环增强。

Target a Beast that you can see 在射程内. 目标必须通过感知豁免，否则在持续时间内陷入魅惑。If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spell ends.

【升环施展】
You can target one additional Beast for each 法术位 level above 1.

name: 黯冰狱铠
effect:
升环增强。

Protective magical frost surrounds you. You gain 5 临时生命. If a creature hits you with a melee 攻击检定 before the spell ends, the creature takes 5 冷冻伤害. The spell ends early if you have no 临时生命.

【升环施展】
The 临时生命 and the 冷冻伤害 both increase by 5 for each 法术位 level above 1.
url: https://sites.google.com/view/dnd5e-2/關於法術/核心/艾嘉西斯之鎧-armor-of-agathys

name: 哈达之臂
effect:
力量豁免。2d6黯蚀。成功减半。升环增强。

Invoking Hadar, you cause tendrils to erupt from yourself. Each creature in a 10 尺 光环 originating from you 进行一次力量豁免. 豁免失败时，a target takes 2d6 黯蚀伤害 and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. 豁免成功时目标只受一半伤害。

【升环施展】
使用高于 1 环的法术位时，每高一环伤害增加 1d6。

name: 灾祸术
effect:
专注。魅力豁免。升环增强。

Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see 在射程内 must each make a 魅力豁免. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an 攻击检定 or a 豁免 before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the 攻击检定 or save.

【升环施展】
使用高于 1 环的法术位时，每高一环可多选一个目标。

name: 祝福术
effect:
专注。升环增强。

你祝福射程内至多三个生物。直至法术结束，目标进行攻击检定或豁免时额外加上 1d4。

【升环施展】
使用高于 1 环的法术位时，每高一环可多选一个目标。

name: 燃烧之手
effect:
敏捷豁免。3d6火焰。成功减半。升环增强。

A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. Each creature in a 15 尺 锥状 进行一次敏捷豁免，受到 3d6 火焰伤害 豁免失败时 ，豁免成功则受到一半伤害.
Flammable objects in the 锥状 that aren't being worn or carried start 燃烧.

【升环施展】
使用高于 1 环的法术位时，每高一环伤害增加 1d6。

name: 魅惑类人
effect:
感知豁免。升环增强。

One Humanoid you can see 在射程内 进行一次感知豁免. 若你或盟友正在与它战斗，该豁免具有优势。豁免失败时，the target has the 魅惑 状态 直至法术结束 or until you or your allies damage it. The 魅惑 creature is 友方 to you. 法术结束时，目标知道自己曾被你魅惑。

【升环施展】
使用高于 1 环的法术位时，每高一环可多选一个目标。

name: 繁彩球
effect:
远程法术攻击。3d8自选。升环增强。

You hurl an orb of energy at a target 在射程内. Choose 强酸, 冷冻, 火焰, 闪电, 毒素, or 雷鸣 for the type of orb you create, and then make a ranged spell attack against the target. 若命中，目标受到 3d8 damage of the chosen type.

One creature of your choice that you can see 在射程内 进行一次感知豁免. 豁免失败时，it has the 倒地 and 失能 状态s 在持续时间内. During that time, it laughs uncontrollably if it's capable of laughter, and it can't end the 倒地 状态 on itself.

name: 谭森浮碟术
effect:
仪式。

This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 尺 in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 尺 above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see 在射程内. The disk remains 在持续时间内 and can hold up to 500 pounds. If more weight is placed on it, the spell ends, and everything on the disk falls to the ground.
The disk is immobile while you are within 20 尺 of it. If you move more than 20 尺 away from it, the disk follows you so that it remains within 20 尺 of you. name: 雷鸣斩
effect:
力量豁免。2d6雷鸣。升环增强。

Your strike rings with thunder that is audible within 300 尺 of you, and the target takes an extra 2d6 雷鸣伤害 from the attack. Additionally, if the target is a creature, it 必须通过一次力量豁免，否则 be pushed 10 尺 away from you and have the 倒地 状态.

effect:
体质豁免。2d8雷鸣。成功减半。升环增强。

You unleash a wave of thunderous energy. Each creature in a 15 尺 立方 originating from you 进行一次体质豁免. 豁免失败时，a creature takes 2d8 雷鸣伤害 and is pushed 10 尺 away from you. 豁免成功时，a creature takes half as much damage only.
In addition, unsecured objects that are entirely within the 立方 are pushed 10 尺 away from you, and a thunderous boom is audible within 300 尺.

【升环施展】

name: 隐形仆役
effect:
仪式。

This spell creates an 隐形, mindless, shapeless, Medium force that performs simple tasks at your command 直至法术结束. The servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground 在射程内. It has AC 10, 1 生命值, and a Strength of 2, and it can't attack. 若其生命值降至 0，法术结束。
Once on each of your turns as a 附赠动作, you can mentally command the servant to move up to 15 尺 and interact with an object. The servant can perform simple tasks that a human could do, such as fetching things, cleaning, mending, folding clothes, lighting fires, serving food, and pouring drinks. If you command the servant to perform a task that would move it more than 60 尺 away from you, the spell ends.

name: 巫术箭
effect:
专注。远程法术攻击。2d12闪电。升环增强。

A beam of crackling energy lances toward a creature 在射程内, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target. Make a ranged spell attack against it. 若命中，目标受到 2d12 闪电伤害.
On each of your subsequent turns, you can take a 附赠动作 to deal 1d12 闪电伤害 to the target automatically, even if the first attack missed.
The spell ends if the target is ever outside the spell's range or if it has Total 掩护 from you.

【升环施展】
The initial damage increases by 1d12 for each 法术位 level above 1.

name: 激愤斩
effect:
感知豁免。1d6黯蚀。升环增强。

The target takes an extra 1d6 黯蚀伤害 from the attack, and it 必须通过一次感知豁免，否则 have the 恐慌 状态 直至法术结束. At the end of each of its turns, the 恐慌 target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

【升环施展】
使用高于 1 环的法术位时，每高一环伤害增加 1d6。

name: 援助术
effect:

Choose up to three creatures 在射程内. Each target's 生命值 maximum and current 生命值 increase by 5 在持续时间内.

【升环施展】
Each target's 生命值 increase by 5 for each 法术位 level above 2.

name: 变身术
effect:
专注。1d6自选。

You alter your physical form. Choose one of the following options. Its effects last 在持续时间内, during which you can take a 施法 action to replace the option you chose with a different one.
【Aquatic Adaptation】
You sprout gills and grow webs between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your 速度.
【Change Appearance】
You alter your appearance. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and other distinguishing characteristics. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change. You can't appear as a creature of a different size, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this spell to become quadrupedal, for instance. For the duration, you can take a 施法 action to change your appearance in this way again.
【Natural Weapons】
You grow claws (挥砍), fangs (穿刺), horns (穿刺), or hooves (钝击). When you use your 徒手打击 to deal damage with that new growth, it deals 1d6 damage of the type in parentheses instead of dealing the normal damage for your 徒手打击, and you use your 施法属性调整值 for the attack and damage rolls rather than using Strength.

name: 动物信使
effect:
仪式。魅力豁免。升环增强。

A miscellaneous=!swarm of your choice that you can see 在射程内 must succeed on a 魅力豁免, or it attempts to deliver a message for you (if the target's Challenge Rating isn't 0, it automatically succeeds). You specify a location you have visited and a recipient who matches a general description, such as "a person dressed in the uniform of the town guard" or "a red-haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat." You also communicate a message of up to twenty-five words. The Beast travels 在持续时间内 toward the specified location, covering about 25 里 per 24 hours or 50 里 if the Beast can fly.
When the Beast arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, mimicking your communication. If the Beast doesn't reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the Beast returns to where you cast the spell.

【升环施展】
The spell's duration increases by 48 hours for each 法术位 level above 2.

name: 秘法锁
effect:

You touch a closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch and magically lock it 在持续时间内. This lock can't be unlocked by any nonmagical means. You and any creatures you designate when you cast the spell can open and close the object despite the lock. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 尺 of the object, unlocks it for 1 minute.
materials: gold dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

name: 复苏秘法

You tap into your life force to heal yourself. Roll one or two of your unexpended Hit Point Dice, and regain a number of 生命值 equal to the roll's total 加上你的施法属性调整值。Those dice are then expended.

The number of unexpended Hit Dice you can roll increases by one for each 法术位 level above 2.

You receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The DM chooses the omen from the Omens table.
Omens

1 尺石/土/木、1 寸金属或一层薄铅可阻挡此法术。
【Read Thoughts】
Target one creature you can see within 30 尺 of yourself or one creature within 30 尺 of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing.

You touch one willing creature, and choose 强酸, 冷冻, 火焰, 闪电, or 毒素. 直至法术结束，the target can take a 施法 action to exhale a 15 尺 锥状. Each creature in that area 进行一次敏捷豁免，受到 3d6 damage of the chosen type 豁免失败时 ，豁免成功则受到一半伤害.

You touch a creature and choose Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. For the duration, the target has 优势 on 属性检定 using the chosen ability.

name: 变巨/缩小术

专注。体质豁免。

For the duration, the spell enlarges or reduces a creature or an object you can see 在射程内 (see the chosen effect below). A targeted object must be neither worn nor carried. If the target is an unwilling creature, it can make a 体质豁免. 豁免成功时，the spell has no effect.
Everything that a targeted creature is wearing and carrying changes size with it. Any item it drops returns to normal size at once. A thrown weapon or piece of ammunition returns to normal size immediately after it hits or misses a target.
【Enlarge】
The target's size increases by one category—from Medium to Large, for example. The target also has 优势 on Strength checks and 力量豁免s. The target's attacks with its enlarged weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage on a hit.

You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see 在射程内 to make a 感知豁免. Any creature you or your companions are fighting automatically succeeds on this save. 豁免失败时，a target has a -10 penalty to Wisdom (察觉) checks and Passive 察觉 直至法术结束.

You summon an otherworldly being that appears as a loyal steed in an unoccupied space of your choice 在射程内. This creature uses the Otherworldly Steed stat block. If you already have a steed from this spell, the steed is replaced by the new one.

【Combat】
The steed is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your 先攻 count, and it functions as a controlled mount while you ride it (as defined in the rules on Mounted Combat). If you have the 失能 状态, the steed takes its turn immediately after yours and acts independently, focusing on protecting you.
【Disappearance of the Steed】
The steed disappears if it drops to 0 生命值 or if you die. When it disappears, it leaves behind anything it was wearing or carrying. If you cast this spell again, you decide whether you summon the steed that disappeared or a different one.

【升环施展】
用该法术位环阶作为资料卡中的法术环阶。

You sense any trap 在射程内 that is within line of sight. A trap, for the purpose of this spell, includes any object or mechanism that was created to cause damage or other danger. Thus, the spell would sense the 警报术 or 守卫刻文 spell or a mechanical pit trap, but it wouldn't reveal a natural weakness in the floor, an unstable ceiling, or a hidden sinkhole.
This spell reveals that a trap is present but not its location. You do learn the general nature of the danger posed by a trap you sense.

name: 火焰刀
effect:
专注。近战法术攻击。3d6火焰。升环增强。

You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a scimitar, and it lasts 在持续时间内. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke it again as a 附赠动作.

【升环施展】
使用高于 2 环的法术位时，每高一环伤害增加 1d6。

专注。敏捷豁免。2d6火焰。成功减半。升环增强。

You create a 5 尺-diameter sphere of fire in an unoccupied space on the ground 在射程内. 持续直至法术结束。Any creature that ends its turn within 5 尺 of the sphere 进行一次敏捷豁免，受到 2d6 火焰伤害 豁免失败时 ，豁免成功则受到一半伤害.
As a 附赠动作, you can move the sphere up to 30 尺, rolling it along the ground. If you move the sphere into a creature's space, that creature makes the save against the sphere, and the sphere stops moving for the turn.
When you move the sphere, you can direct it over barriers up to 5 尺 tall and jump it across pits up to 10 尺 wide. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried start 燃烧 if touched by the sphere, and it sheds 明亮光照 in a 20 尺 radius and 微光 for an additional 20 尺.

【升环施展】
使用高于 2 环的法术位时，每高一环伤害增加 1d6。

You touch a corpse or other remains. For the duration, the target is protected from decay and can't become Undead.

The gust disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles and similar unprotected flames in the area. It causes protected flames, such as those of lanterns, to dance wildly and has a 50% chance to extinguish them.
As a 附赠动作 on your later turns, you can change the direction in which the 线状 blasts from you.

Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of Heavy or Medium metal armor, that you can see 在射程内. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 火焰伤害 when you cast the spell. 直至法术结束，you can take a 附赠动作 on each of your later turns to deal this damage again if the object is 在射程内.
If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage from it, the creature 必须通过一次体质豁免，否则 drop the object if it can. If it doesn't drop the object, it has 劣势 on 攻击检定s and 属性检定 直至你的下个回合开始.

A target that is held shut by a mundane lock or that is stuck or barred becomes unlocked, unstuck, or unbarred. If the object has multiple locks, only one of them is unlocked.

name: 浮空术

You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area, which must be at least 50 尺 square and 25 尺 deep. The whirlpool lasts until you choose a different effect or the spell ends. name: 托梦术
effect:
感知豁免。3d6心灵。

You target a creature you know on the same plane of existence. You or a willing creature you touch enters a trance state to act as a dream messenger. While in the trance, the messenger is 失能 and has a 速度 of 0.
If the target is asleep, the messenger appears in the target's dreams and can converse with the target as long as it remains asleep, through the spell's duration. The messenger can also shape the dream's environment, creating landscapes, objects, and other images. The messenger can emerge from the trance at any time, ending the spell. The target recalls the dream perfectly upon waking.
If the target is awake when you cast the spell, the messenger knows it and can either end the trance (and the spell) or wait for the target to sleep, at which point the messenger enters its dreams.
You can make the messenger terrifying to the target. If you do so, the messenger can deliver a message of no more than ten words, and then the target 进行一次感知豁免. 豁免失败时，the target gains no benefit from its rest, and it takes 3d6 心灵伤害 when it wakes up.

name: 焰击术
effect:
敏捷豁免。5d6自选。成功减半。升环增强。

A vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10 尺半径, 40 尺-high 柱状 centered on a point 在射程内 进行一次敏捷豁免，受到 5d6 火焰伤害 and 5d6 光耀伤害 豁免失败时 ，豁免成功则受到一半伤害.

【升环施展】
The 火焰伤害 and the 光耀伤害 increase by 1d6 for each 法术位 level above 5.

name: 指使术
effect:
感知豁免。5d10心灵。升环增强。

You give a verbal command to a creature that you can see 在射程内, ordering it to carry out some service or refrain from an action or a course of activity as you decide. 目标必须通过感知豁免，否则在持续时间内陷入魅惑。The target automatically succeeds if it can't understand your command.
While 魅惑, the creature takes 5d10 心灵伤害 if it acts in a manner directly counter to your command. It takes this damage no more than once each day.
You can issue any command you choose, short of an activity that would result in certain death. Should you issue a suicidal command, the spell ends.
A 移除诅咒, 高等复原术, or 祈愿术 spell ends this spell.

【升环施展】
If you use a level 7 or 8 法术位, the duration is 365 days. If you use a level 9 法术位, the spell lasts until it is ended by one of the spells mentioned above.

name: 高等复原术
effect:
见规则书。

You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:
• 1 力竭 level
• The 魅惑 or 石化 状态
• A curse, including the target's Attunement to a cursed magic item
• Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores
• Any reduction to the target's 生命值 maximum
materials: diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

name: 圣居
effect:
见规则书。

You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy or unholy power. The area can have a radius up to 60 尺, and the spell fails if the radius includes an area already under the effect of Hallow. The affected area has the following effects.
【Hallowed Ward】
Choose any of these creature types: Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead. Creatures of the chosen types can't willingly enter the area, and any creature that is possessed by or that has the 魅惑 or 恐慌 状态 from such creatures isn't possessed, 魅惑, or 恐慌 by them while in the area.
【Extra Effect】
You bind an extra effect to the area from the list below:
• Courage：Creatures of any types you choose can't gain the 恐慌 状态 while in the area.
• Darkness：黑暗 fills the area. Normal light, as well as magical light created by spells of a level lower than this spell, can't illuminate the area.
• Daylight：Bright light fills the area. Magical 黑暗 created by spells of a level lower than this spell can't extinguish the light.
• Peaceful Rest：Dead bodies interred in the area can't be turned into Undead.
• Extradimensional Interference：Creatures of any types you choose can't enter or exit the area using teleportation or interplanar travel.
• Fear：Creatures of any types you choose have the 恐慌 状态 while in the area.
• Resistance：Creatures of any types you choose have Resistance to one damage type of your choice while in the area.
• Silence：No sound can emanate from within the area, and no sound can reach into it.
• Tongues：Creatures of any types you choose can communicate with any other creature in the area even if they don't share a common language.
• Vulnerability：Creatures of any types you choose have Vulnerability to one damage type of your choice while in the area.
materials: incense worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

name: 定身怪物
effect:
专注。感知豁免。升环增强。

选择射程内你能看见的一个生物。目标必须通过感知豁免，否则在持续时间内陷入麻痹。目标在其每回合结束时重复豁免，成功则自身结束此法术。

【升环施展】
使用高于 5 环的法术位时，每高一环可多选一个目标。

name: 疫病虫群
effect:
专注。体质豁免。4d10穿刺。成功减半。升环增强。

Swarming locusts fill a 20 尺半径 球状 centered on a point you choose 在射程内. The 球状 remains 在持续时间内, and its area is Lightly Obscured and 困难地形.
When the swarm appears, each creature in it 进行一次体质豁免, 受到 4d10 穿刺伤害 豁免失败时 ，豁免成功则受到一半伤害. 生物在一回合内首次进入法术区域或在其中结束回合时，也要进行此豁免。每个生物每回合只需进行一次此豁免。

【升环施展】
使用高于 5 环的法术位时，每高一环伤害增加 1d10。

name: 贾拉兹光耀风暴
effect:
专注。体质豁免。2d10自选。成功减半。升环增强。

You unleash a storm of flashing light and raging thunder in a 10 尺半径, 40 尺-high 柱状 centered on a point you can see 在射程内. While in this area, creatures have the 目盲 and 耳聋 状态s, and they can't cast spells with a Verbal component.
When the storm appears, each creature in it 进行一次体质豁免, 受到 2d10 光耀伤害 and 2d10 雷鸣伤害 豁免失败时 ，豁免成功则受到一半伤害. 生物在一回合内首次进入法术区域或在其中结束回合时，也要进行此豁免。每个生物每回合只需进行一次此豁免。

【升环施展】
The 光耀 and 雷鸣伤害 increase by 1d10 for each 法术位 level above 5.
url: https://sites.google.com/view/dnd5e-2/關於法術/核心/賈拉茲光耀風暴-jallarzis-storm-of-radiance

name: 通晓传奇
effect:
见规则书。

Name or describe a famous person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about that famous thing, as described by the DM.
The lore might consist of important details, amusing revelations, or even secret lore that has never been widely known. The more information you already know about the thing, the more precise and detailed the information you receive is. That information is accurate but might be couched in figurative language or poetry, as determined by the DM.
If the famous thing you chose isn't actually famous, you hear sad musical notes played on a trombone, and the spell fails.
materials: incense worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes, and four ivory strips worth 50+ GP each

name: 群体疗伤术
effect:
恢复 5d8+调整值 生命。升环增强。

A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you can see 在射程内. Choose up to six creatures in a 30 尺半径 球状 centered on that point. Each target regains 生命值 equal to 5d8 加上你的施法属性调整值。

【升环施展】
使用高于 5 环的法术位时，每高一环治疗量增加 1d8。
url: https://sites.google.com/view/dnd5e-2/關於法術/核心/群體治療傷勢-mass-cure-wounds

name: 假象术
effect:
专注。

You gain the 隐形 状态 at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. The double lasts 在持续时间内, but the invisibility ends immediately after you make an 攻击检定, deal damage, or cast a spell.
As a 施法 action, you can move the illusory double up to twice your 速度 and make it gesture, speak, and behave in whatever way you choose. It is intangible and invulnerable.
You can see through its eyes and hear through its ears as if you were located where it is.

name: 篡改记忆
effect:
专注。感知豁免。升环增强。

You attempt to reshape another creature's memories. 射程内你能看见的一个生物 进行一次感知豁免. If you are fighting the creature, it has 优势 on the save. 豁免失败时，the target has the 魅惑 状态 在持续时间内. While 魅惑 in this way, the target also has the 失能 状态 and is unaware of its surroundings, though it can hear you. If it takes any damage or is targeted by another spell, this spell ends, and no memories are modified.
While this charm lasts, you can affect the target's memory of an event that it experienced within the last 24 hours and that lasted no more than 10 minutes. You can permanently eliminate all memory of the event, allow the target to recall the event with perfect clarity, change its memory of the event's details, or create a memory of some other event.
You must speak to the target to describe how its memories are affected, and it must be able to understand your language for the modified memories to take root. Its mind fills in any gaps in the details of your description. If the spell ends before you finish describing the modified memories, the creature's memory isn't altered. Otherwise, the modified memories take hold when the spell ends.
A modified memory doesn't necessarily affect how a creature behaves, particularly if the memory contradicts the creature's natural inclinations, alignment, or beliefs. An illogical modified memory, such as a false memory of how much the creature enjoyed swimming in acid, is dismissed as a bad dream. The DM might deem a modified memory too nonsensical to affect a creature.
A 移除诅咒 or 高等复原术 spell cast on the target restores the creature's true memory.

【升环施展】
You can alter the target's memories of an event that took place up to 7 days ago (level 6 法术位), 30 days ago (level 7 法术位), 365 days ago (level 8 法术位), or any time in the creature's past (level 9 法术位).

name: 穿墙术
effect:
见规则书。

A passage appears at a point that you can see on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, ceiling, or floor) 在射程内 and lasts 在持续时间内. You choose the opening's dimensions: up to 5 尺 wide, 8 尺 tall, and 20 尺 deep. The passage creates no instability in a structure surrounding it.
When the opening disappears, any creatures or objects still in the passage created by the spell are safely ejected to an unoccupied space nearest to the surface on which you cast the spell.

name: 异界誓缚
effect:
魅力豁免。升环增强。

You attempt to bind a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend to your service. The creature must be 在射程内 for the entire casting of the spell. (Typically, the creature is first summoned into the center of the inverted version of the 防护法阵 spell to trap it while this spell is cast.) At the completion of the casting, the target 必须通过一次魅力豁免，否则 be bound to serve you 在持续时间内. If the creature was summoned or created by another spell, that spell's duration is extended to match the duration of this spell.
A bound creature must follow your commands to the best of its ability. You might command the creature to accompany you on an adventure, to guard a location, or to deliver a message. If the creature is 敌对, it strives to twist your commands to achieve its own objectives. If the creature carries out your commands completely before the spell ends, it travels to you to report this fact if you are on the same plane of existence. If you are on a different plane, it returns to the place where you bound it and remains there 直至法术结束.

【升环施展】
The duration increases with a 法术位 of level 6 (10 days), 7 (30 days), 8 (180 days), and 9 (366 days).
materials: a jewel worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

name: 死者复活
effect:
见规则书。

With a touch, you revive a dead creature if it has been dead no longer than 10 days and it wasn't Undead when it died.
The creature returns to life with 1 生命值. This spell also neutralizes any poisons that affected the creature at the time of death.
This spell closes all mortal wounds, but it doesn't restore missing body parts. If the creature is lacking body parts or organs integral for its survival—its head, for instance—the spell automatically fails.
Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a -4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a 长休, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.
materials: a diamond worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

name: 拉瑞心灵联结
effect:
仪式。

You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice 在射程内, psychically linking each creature to all the others 在持续时间内. Creatures that can't communicate in any languages aren't affected by this spell.
直至法术结束，the targets can communicate telepathically through the bond whether or not they share a language. The communication is possible over any distance, though it can't extend to other planes of existence.
url: https://sites.google.com/view/dnd5e-2/關於法術/核心/拉瑞心靈聯結-rarys-telepathic-bond

name: 转生术
effect:
见规则书。

You touch a dead Humanoid or a piece of one. If the creature has been dead no longer than 10 days, the spell forms a new body for it and calls the soul to enter that body. Roll 1d10 and consult the table below to determine the body's species, or the DM chooses another playable species.
1d10 | Species
1 | Aasimar
2 | Dragonborn
3 | Dwarf
4 | Elf
5 | Gnome
6 | Goliath
7 | Halfling
8 | Human
9 | Orc
10 | Tiefling
The reincarnated creature makes any choices that a species' description offers, and the creature recalls its former life. It retains the capabilities it had in its original form, except it loses the traits of its previous species and gains the traits of its new one.
materials: rare oils worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

name: 探知术
effect:
专注。感知豁免。

You can see and hear a creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target 进行一次感知豁免, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. The target doesn't know what it is making the save against, only that it feels uneasy.
Your Knowledge of the Target Is... | Save Modifier
Secondhand (heard of the target) | +5
Firsthand (met the target) | +0
Extensive (know the target well) | -5
You Have the Target's... | Save Modifier
Picture or other likeness | -2
Garment or other possession | -4
Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail | -10
豁免成功时，the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell on it again for 24 hours.
豁免失败时，the spell creates an 隐形, intangible sensor within 10 尺 of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 尺 of it 在持续时间内. If something can see the sensor, it appears as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.
Instead of targeting a creature, you can target a location you have seen. When you do so, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.
materials: a focus worth 1,000+ GP, such as a crystal ball, mirror, or water-filled font

name: 伪装术
effect:
魅力豁免。

You give an illusory appearance to each creature of your choice that you can see 在射程内. An unwilling target can make a 魅力豁免, and if it succeeds, it is unaffected by this spell.
You can give the same appearance or different ones to the targets. The spell can change the appearance of the targets' bodies and equipment. You can make each creature seem 1 尺 shorter or taller and appear heavier or lighter. A target's new appearance must have the same basic arrangement of limbs as the target, but the extent of the illusion is otherwise up to you. The spell lasts 在持续时间内.
The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to a creature's outfit, objects pass through the hat.
A creature that takes the 研读 action to examine a target can make an Intelligence (调查) check against your 法术豁免 DC. If it succeeds, it becomes aware that the target is disguised.

name: 钢风斩
effect:
近战法术攻击。6d10力场。

You flourish the weapon used in the casting and then vanish to strike like the wind. Choose up to five creatures you can see 在射程内. Make a melee spell attack against each target. 若命中，a target takes 6d10 力场伤害.
You then teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 尺 of one of the targets.

name: 天界召唤术
effect:
专注。升环增强。

You call forth a Celestial spirit. It manifests in an angelic form in an unoccupied space that you can see 在射程内 and uses the Celestial Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose Avenger or Defender. Your choice determines certain details in its stat block. 该生物生命值降至 0 或法术结束时消失。
该生物是你与你盟友的盟友。战斗中它与你共用先攻，但其回合紧接在你之后。它服从你的口头命令（你无需消耗动作）。若你没有下令，它执行回避并移动以远离危险。

【升环施展】
用该法术位环阶作为资料卡中的法术环阶。

name: 龙类召唤术
effect:
专注。升环增强。

You call forth a Dragon spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see 在射程内 and uses the Draconic Spirit stat block. 该生物生命值降至 0 或法术结束时消失。
该生物是你与你盟友的盟友。战斗中它与你共用先攻，但其回合紧接在你之后。它服从你的口头命令（你无需消耗动作）。若你没有下令，它执行回避并移动以远离危险。

【升环施展】
用该法术位环阶作为资料卡中的法术环阶。
materials: an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it worth 500+ GP

name: 迅捷箭袋
effect:
专注。

When you cast the spell and as a 附赠动作 until it ends, you can make two attacks with a weapon that fires Arrows or Bolts, such as a Longbow or a Light Crossbow. The spell magically creates the ammunition needed for each attack. Each Arrow or Bolt created by the spell deals damage like a nonmagical piece of ammunition of its kind and disintegrates immediately after it hits or misses.

name: 突触静止
effect:
智力豁免。8d6心灵。成功减半。

You cause psychic energy to erupt at a point 在射程内. 以该点为中心 20 尺半径球状内的每个生物 进行一次智力豁免, 受到 8d6 心灵伤害 豁免失败时 ，豁免成功则受到一半伤害.
豁免失败时，a target also has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it subtracts 1d6 from all its 攻击检定s and 属性检定, as well as any 体质豁免s to maintain 专注. The target 进行一次智力豁免 at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: 心灵遥控
effect:
专注。力量豁免。

You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell and as a 施法 action on your later turns before the spell ends, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see 在射程内, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the spell.
【Creature】
You can try to move a Huge or smaller creature. The target must succeed on a 力量豁免, or you move it up to 30 尺 in any direction within the spell's range. Until the end of your next turn, the creature has the 束缚 状态, and if you lift it into the air, it is suspended there. It falls at the end of your next turn unless you use this option on it again and it fails the save.
【Object】
You can try to move a Huge or smaller object. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 尺 in any direction within the spell's range.
If the object is worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a 力量豁免, or you pull the object away and move it up to 30 尺 in any direction within the spell's range.
You can exert fine control on objects with your telekinetic grip, such as manipulating a simple tool, opening a door or a container, stowing or retrieving an item from an open container, or pouring the contents from a vial.

name: 传送法阵
effect:
见规则书。

As you cast the spell, you draw a 5 尺半径 circle on the ground inscribed with sigils that link your location to a permanent teleportation circle of your choice whose sigil sequence you know and that is on the same plane of existence as you. A shimmering portal opens within the circle you drew and remains open until the end of your next turn. Any creature that enters the portal instantly appears within 5 尺 of the destination circle or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
Many major temples, guildhalls, and other important places have permanent teleportation circles. Each circle includes a unique sigil sequence—a string of runes arranged in a particular pattern.
When you first gain the ability to cast this spell, you learn the sigil sequences for two destinations on the Material Plane, determined by the DM. You might learn additional sigil sequences during your adventures. You can commit a new sigil sequence to memory after studying it for 1 minute.
You can create a permanent teleportation circle by casting this spell in the same location every day for 365 days.
materials: rare inks worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes

name: 树跃术
effect:
专注。

You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 尺. Both trees must be living and at least the same size as you. You must use 5 尺 of movement to enter a tree. You instantly know the location of all other trees of the same kind within 500 尺 and, as part of the move used to enter the tree, can either pass into one of those trees or step out of the tree you're in. You appear in a spot of your choice within 5 尺 of the destination tree, using another 5 尺 of movement. If you have no movement left, you appear within 5 尺 of the tree you entered.
You can use this transportation ability only once on each of your turns. You must end each turn outside a tree.

name: 力场墙
effect:
专注。

An 隐形 wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose 在射程内. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a globe with a radius of up to 10 尺, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10 尺-by-10 尺 panels. 每块墙板必须与另一块相连。In any form, the wall is 1/4 inch thick and lasts 在持续时间内. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side).
Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by 解除魔法. A 解离术 spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane and blocks ethereal travel through the wall.

name: 石墙术
effect:
专注。敏捷豁免。

A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose 在射程内. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10 尺-by-10 尺 panels. 每块墙板必须与另一块相连。Alternatively, you can create 10 尺-by-20 尺 panels that are only 3 inches thick.
If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a 敏捷豁免. On a success, it can use its 反应 to move up to its 速度 so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.
The wall can have any shape you desire, though it can't occupy the same space as a creature or object. The wall doesn't need to be vertical or rest on a firm foundation. It must, however, merge with and be solidly supported by existing stone. Thus, you can use this spell to bridge a chasm or create a ramp.
If you create a span greater than 20 尺 in length, you must halve the size of each panel to create supports. You can crudely shape the wall to create battlements and the like.
The wall is an object made of stone that can be damaged and thus breached. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 生命值 per inch of thickness, and it has Immunity to 毒素 and 心灵伤害. Reducing a panel to 0 生命值 destroys it and might cause connected panels to collapse at the DM's discretion.
If you maintain your 专注 on this spell for its full duration, the wall becomes permanent and can't be dispelled. Otherwise, the wall disappears when the spell ends.

name: 悠兰德王者威仪
effect:

name: 传送术
effect:
3d10力场。

This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures that you can see 在射程内, or a single object that you can see 在射程内, to a destination you select. If you target an object, it must be Large or smaller, and it can't be held or carried by an unwilling creature.
The destination you choose must be known to you, and it must be on the same plane of existence as you. Your familiarity with the destination determines whether you arrive there successfully. The DM rolls 1d100 and consults the Teleportation Outcome table and the explanations after it.
Teleportation Outcome
Familiarity | Mishap | Similar Area | Off Target | On Target
Permanent circle | — | — | — | 01-00
Linked object | — | — | — | 01-00
Very familiar | 01-05 | 06-13 | 14-24 | 25-00
Seen casually | 01-33 | 34-43 | 44-53 | 54-00
Viewed once or described | 01-43 | 44-53 | 54-73 | 74-00
False destination | 01-50 | 51-00 | — | —
【Familiarity】
Here are the meanings of the terms in the table's Familiarity column:
• "Permanent circle" means a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know.
• "Linked object" means you possess an object taken from the desired destination within the last six months, such as a book from a wizard's library.
• "Very familiar" is a place you have visited often, a place you have carefully studied, or a place you can see when you cast the spell.
• "Seen casually" is a place you have seen more than once but with which you aren't very familiar.
• "Viewed once or described" is a place you have seen once, possibly using magic, or a place you know through someone else's description, perhaps from a map.
• "False destination" is a place that doesn't exist. Perhaps you tried to scry an enemy's sanctum but instead viewed an illusion, or you are attempting to teleport to a location that no longer exists.
【Mishap】
The spell's unpredictable magic results in a difficult journey. Each teleporting creature (or the target object) takes 3d10 力场伤害, and the DM rerolls on the table to see where you wind up (multiple mishaps can occur, dealing damage each time).
【Similar Area】
You and your group (or the target object) appear in a different area that's visually or thematically similar to the target area. You appear in the closest similar place. If you are heading for your home laboratory, for example, you might appear in another person's laboratory in the same city.
【Off Target】
You and your group (or the target object) appear 2d12 里 away from the destination in a random direction. Roll 1d8 for the direction: 1, east; 2, southeast; 3, south; 4, southwest; 5, west; 6, northwest; 7, north; or 8, northeast.
【On Target】
You and your group (or the target object) appear where you intended.

Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see 在射程内. Each target shape-shifts into a Large or smaller Beast of your choice that has a Challenge Rating of 4 or lower. You can choose a different form for each target. On later turns, you can take a 施法 action to transform the targets again.

The target's actions are limited by the Beast form's anatomy, and it can't cast spells. The target's equipment melds into the new form, and the target can't use any of that equipment while in that form.

name: 反魔法场
effect:
专注。

An aura of antimagic surrounds you in a 10 尺 光环. No one can cast spells, take 施法 actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura, and those things can't target or otherwise affect anything inside it. Magical properties of magic items don't work inside the aura or on anything inside it.
Areas of effect created by spells or other magic can't extend into the aura, and no one can teleport into or out of it or use planar travel there. Portals close temporarily while in the aura.
Ongoing spells, except those cast by an Artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the area. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration.
解除魔法 has no effect on the aura, and the auras created by different 反魔法场 spells don't nullify each other.

name: 嫌恶术/关怀术
effect:
感知豁免。

As you cast the spell, choose whether it creates antipathy or sympathy, and target one creature or object that is Huge or smaller. Then specify a kind of creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires. A creature of the chosen kind 进行一次感知豁免 when it comes within 120 尺 of the target. Your choice of antipathy or sympathy determines what happens to a creature when it fails that save:
• Antipathy：The creature has the 恐慌 状态. The 恐慌 creature must use its movement on its turns to get as far away as possible from the target, moving by the safest route.
• Sympathy：The creature has the 魅惑 状态. The 魅惑 creature must use its movement on its turns to get as close as possible to the target, moving by the safest route. If the creature is within 5 尺 of the target, the creature can't willingly move away. If the target damages the 魅惑 creature, that creature can make a 感知豁免 to end the effect, as described below.

If the 恐慌 or 魅惑 creature ends its turn more than 120 尺 away from the target, the creature 进行一次感知豁免. 豁免成功时，the creature is no longer affected by the target. A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which it can be affected again.

豁免失败时，the target takes 10d12 心灵伤害 and can't cast spells or take the 施法 action. At the end of every 30 days, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on a success. The effect can also be ended by the 高等复原术, 医疗术, or 祈愿术 spell.

An inert duplicate of that creature forms inside the vessel used in the spell's casting and finishes growing after 120 days; you choose whether the finished clone is the same age as the creature or younger. The creature's original remains, if any, become inert and can't be revived, since the creature's soul is elsewhere.

If that creature is on a plane other than the one you are on, the portal opens next to the named creature and transports it to the nearest unoccupied space on your side of the portal. You gain no special power over the creature, and it is free to act as the DM deems appropriate. It might leave, attack you, or help you.

name: 禁锢术

感知豁免。

You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see 在射程内. The target must make a 感知豁免. 豁免成功时，the target is unaffected, and it is immune to this spell for the next 24 hours. 豁免失败时，the target is imprisoned. While imprisoned, the target doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Divination spells can't locate or perceive the imprisoned target, and the target can't teleport.
直至法术结束，the target is also affected by one of the following effects of your choice:
• Burial：The target is entombed beneath the earth in a hollow globe of magical force that is just large enough to contain the target. Nothing can pass into or out of the globe.
• Chaining：Chains firmly rooted in the ground hold the target in place. The target has the 束缚 状态 and can't be moved by any means.

When you cast the spell, specify a trigger that will end it. The trigger must be an observable action, such as someone making a particular offering at the temple of your god, saving your true love, or defeating a specific monster.

12d12心灵。

A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 尺 long, 30 尺 high, and 1 inch thick—centered on a point 在射程内. Each layer forces the creature to make a 敏捷豁免 or be affected by that layer's properties as described in the Prismatic Layers table.

Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see 在射程内. The creature shape-shifts into a different creature or a nonmagical object, or the object shape-shifts into a creature (the object must be neither worn nor carried). The transformation lasts 在持续时间内 or until the target dies or is destroyed, but if you maintain 专注 on this spell for the full duration, the spell lasts until dispelled.

The target's game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the new form, but it retains its 生命值, Hit Point Dice, alignment, and personality.

The creature's statistics become those of the object, and the creature has no memory of time spent in this form after the spell ends and it returns to normal.

name: 祈愿术
effect:
见规则书。

Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter reality itself.
The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of level 8 or lower. If you use it this way, you don't need to meet any requirements to cast that spell, including costly components. The spell simply takes effect.
Alternatively, you can create one of the following effects of your choice:
• Object Creation：You create one object of up to 25,000 GP in value that isn't a magic item. The object can be no more than 300 尺 in any dimension, and it appears in an unoccupied space that you can see on the ground.
• Instant Health：You allow yourself and up to twenty creatures that you can see to regain all 生命值, and you end all effects on them listed in the 高等复原术 spell.
• Resistance：You grant up to ten creatures that you can see Resistance to one damage type that you choose. This Resistance is permanent.
• Spell Immunity：You grant up to ten creatures you can see immunity to a single spell or other magical effect for 8 hours.
• Sudden Learning：You replace one of your feats with another feat for which you are eligible. You lose all the benefits of the old feat and gain the benefits of the new one. You can't replace a feat that is a prerequisite for any of your other feats or features.
• Roll Redo：You undo a single recent event by forcing a reroll of any die roll made within the last round (including your last turn). Reality reshapes itself to accommodate the new result. For example, a Wish spell could undo an ally's failed 豁免 or a foe's 重击. You can force the reroll to be made with 优势 or 劣势, and you choose whether to use the reroll or the original roll.
• Reshape Reality：You may wish for something not included in any of the other effects. To do so, state your wish to the DM as precisely as possible. The DM has great latitude in ruling what occurs in such an instance; the greater the wish, the greater the likelihood that something goes wrong. This spell might simply fail, the effect you desire might be achieved only in part, or you might suffer an unforeseen consequence as a result of how you worded the wish. For example, wishing that a villain were dead might propel you forward in time to a period when that villain is no longer alive, effectively removing you from the game. Similarly, wishing for a Legendary magic item or an Artifact might instantly transport you to the presence of the item's current owner. If your wish is granted and its effects have consequences for a whole community, region, or world, you are likely to attract powerful foes. If your wish would affect a god, the god's divine servants might instantly intervene to prevent it or to encourage you to craft the wish in a particular way. If your wish would undo the multiverse itself, threaten the City of Sigil, or affect the Lady of Pain in any way, you see an image of her in your mind for a moment; she shakes her head, and your wish fails.
The stress of casting Wish to produce any effect other than duplicating another spell weakens you. After enduring that stress, each time you cast a spell until you finish a 长休, you take 1d10 黯蚀伤害 per level of that spell. This damage can't be reduced or prevented in any way. In addition, your Strength score becomes 3 for 2d4 days. For each of those days that you spend resting and doing nothing more than light activity, your remaining recovery time decreases by 2 days. Finally, there is a 33% chance that you are unable to cast 祈愿术 ever again if you suffer this stress.
